mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as observed in historical monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate rise above 5.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that precede recessionary corporate earnings declines, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal broad-based consumer demand contraction that amplifies corporate revenue risks, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline by >1% month-over-month, or the interaction term regression p-value exceeds 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery, industrial production (INDPRO) rising above its 12-month moving average indicates strengthening manufacturing activity that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days via improved corporate profit visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during post-recession recovery when INDPRO rises above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 5-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 105% of its 12-month average signals robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days via immediate market sentiment improvement.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 105% of its 12-month average, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points in one month signals aggressive monetary tightening that raises borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises by >0.5pp in a month, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate increases above 4.5% signal severe labor market contraction that amplifies recession fears, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises above 4.5%, or the interaction term regression p-value exceeds 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY), a federal funds rate decline signals central bank policy accommodation to counter economic weakness, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days via market expectations of policy support.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% and FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 5-year windows is below 0.02.
